text_block_list.text:
"The bus carrying the students will soon
depart the training camp grounds for Tracen Academy."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Man, what a fulfilling summer that was!
I was able to learn so many things I didn't know before!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Especially romance, which I had zero experience with...
I feel like I finally understand it a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Though she hasn't even stood at the starting line yet!
I was just watching helplessly with my fingers in my mouth!!

—Though it seemed there were a few regrets,
Mejiro Ryan appeared to have thoroughly enjoyed
herself nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"It truly was a heated season.
However—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: The most thrilling part starts right now!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, look at this.
This news footage!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen with another sweeping victory!!
She flashes an effortless smile to her fans!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The McQueen whirlwind sweeps through Hakodate.
A true superstar rookie has arrived!

"The video footage showed Mejiro
McQueen waving gracefully."
"Even so, squeezing into a Classic starting gate from this point won't be easy. But still..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I knew McQueen was coming.
It was what I wanted, too. But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Her pace is faster than I thought. I didn't think
she'd make it in time for the Classics, but could it be...?

Trembling with a mix of trust and awe.
Precisely because Mejiro Ryan knows
the true depth of Mejiro McQueen's power.
Will a typhoon strike? No one knows yet what kind of autumn this will be.
